blocks.html: Among whom there are also three or four kinds of witnesses who are of great consideration. First, the four sisters, of whom we have spoken above: women of worth and honest, if there are any in Gascony; who have always constantly maintained that the prisoner was certainly Martin Guerre their brother, and husband of the said de Rols, and that they knew him perfectly to be such. And the like assurance was given by two of the brothers-in-law of the said Martin, married to two of the said sisters.
